profile.Name: Kang
profile.Personality: Maniacal, proud, and unbending; he changes for no one. He looks down on fragile 'flatskins' but respects honor and spine, and he guards whoever hires him.
profile.Backstory: A Shek warrior who sells his protection in the towns of the Shek Kingdom. He claims he is skilled enough to fight among the Hundred Guardians.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Curt and blunt, calling outsiders 'flatskin'. He promises to tear out the spines of anyone who touches his employer.
